parallel/map#

An ordered mapping performed by bounded batches of isolated process workers.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let mapped is ParallelMapped<int,int> = ParallelMapped(
    origins: [1,2,3], action: Worker(seed: 10).run, workers: 2);
let values = await mapped.results();

Description#

An ordered mapping performed by bounded batches of isolated process workers.

Construction stores the inputs and validates the positive worker bound. The default is the runtime CPU count, read when a run starts. Each results() call creates a fresh lazy run; awaiting the same Future again reuses its completed outcome.

A worker must be a synchronous typed bound action accepted by spawn. Receiver fields must reconstruct its constructor and all boundary values must satisfy the spawn codec. Closures, async actions and arbitrary objects are unsupported. The single-file CLI uses processes; embedded execution uses its configured executor. This module does not turn Local execution into process parallelism.

Batches preserve input order and never exceed workers active children. A batch failure prevents later batches. Input/dispatch failure and caller cancellation also cancel outstanding children and await their cleanup before settlement. Worker failures retain the existing spawn diagnostics, not reconstructed child Error objects. Empty inputs yield an empty sequence without dispatch.
